description: This file implements optical flow computation functions, including Lucas-Kanade and ESM based methods, for tracking points across image frames in TensorFlow's Android object tracking component. It handles image patch extraction, gradient calculations, and iterative flow estimation.

classes.name: tf_tracking::OpticalFlow
classes.description: Class responsible for computing optical flow between image frames, supporting pyramidal Lucas-Kanade and ESM methods, with functions for processing image patches and iterative flow refinement.

methods.name: OpticalFlow::NextFrame
methods.description: Updates internal references to the current and previous frames.

methods.name: OpticalFlow::FindFlowAtPoint_LK
methods.description: Performs Lucas-Kanade optical flow estimation at a specific point between two images.

methods.name: OpticalFlow::FindFlowAtPoint_ESM
methods.description: Performs ESM-based optical flow estimation at a specific point using brightness and gradient matching.

methods.name: OpticalFlow::FindFlowAtPointReversible
methods.description: Estimates flow at a point using reversible flow computation for error checking.

methods.name: OpticalFlow::FindFlowAtPointSingleLevel
methods.description: Estimates flow at a specific pyramid level with optional forward-backward consistency filtering.

methods.name: OpticalFlow::FindFlowAtPointPyramidal
methods.description: Performs pyramidal Lucas-Kanade optical flow estimation from coarse to fine levels.
